## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Treatment

response.rationale: A and B are two different concepts that are linked to each other. A, Treatment, is a record of one treatment given to a hive. TreatmentRepository stores these as TreatmentRecord items (src/persistence/repositories.ts: "private readonly items: TreatmentRecord[] = [];"). B, Treatment Product, is a catalog entry for a product, and it carries product-level data such as the withdrawal period. In HarvestService (src/business/harvestService.ts) a treatment record points to its product through t.productId, and the service looks that product up in a separate repository: "const withdrawal = this.products.findById(t.productId)?.withdrawalDays ?? 0;". The graph shows the same split. HarvestService (node e4a0a62f13370a5f) is injected with both TreatmentRepository and TreatmentProductRepository and calls each of them separately. So a treatment refers to a product, but they are not the same thing under two names.
